product.name: Multi-AI Terminal
product.runtime: Node.js Fastify server serving the built web UI at a local URL

trust.source: the checked-out repository and its locked npm dependencies
trust.warning: Source launch executes repository code and locked JavaScript dependencies. Review the repository before invoking an Agent Skill. No Rust toolchain is used or required in this lane.

audit.sideEffect: writes only an explicitly requested audit file under .agent-runtime

launch.sideEffect: installs locked project dependencies when absent, builds the shared/server/web workspaces, and starts the MAT server on a loopback port

stop.sideEffect: stops only the identity-verified repository launcher process tree and removes its same-run state; an explicit recovery flag can remove corrupt state without terminating an unknown process

common: a local web browser to open the reported URL
windows: no additional requirements; this lane never compiles Rust or native code
macos: no additional requirements; this lane never compiles Rust or native code
linux: no additional requirements; this lane never compiles Rust or native code

allowedByScripts: install locked dependencies into this project with npm ci
build the shared, server, and web workspaces into their dist directories
start this repository's MAT server on a loopback port and inspect it
stop only the identity-verified repository launcher process tree
requiresSeparateExplicitApproval: run winget, brew, apt, rustup, npm --global, sudo, or an elevated installer
deniedBySkill: implicit execution when the repository is opened
tauri build, installer generation, or any Rust compilation
release asset download as part of source launch
provider credential, cookie, storage, or profile access
driving the launched server's provider install, update, or sign-in APIs on the user's behalf
automatic host rollback or toolchain uninstall
remote upload of logs or audit records

repositoryLocal.removal: manual; safe only when no project process is using it

repositoryLocal.when: the shared contracts workspace is built
repositoryLocal.removal: generated; recreated on the next launch
generated; recreated on the next launch
generated; recreated on the next launch

repositoryLocal.when: audit, launch, status logging, or receipts are used
repositoryLocal.removal: manual after the repository launcher is stopped

userCaches: npm may populate its shared content-addressed cache
applicationData: the running MAT server reads and writes its normal data directory (MAT_DATA_DIR or ~/.multi-ai-terminal) for workspaces, workflows, runs, and evidence
do not run this lane at the same time as the installed MAT desktop app: two servers over one data directory race its stores
sideEffects.hostConfigurationByScripts: none; scripts do not install toolchains, modify PATH, elevate privileges, or weaken security settings
sideEffects.automaticRollback: none; shared toolchains, caches, and MAT application data must never be removed automatically

exitCodes.2: invalid command usage or contract data

privacy.credentials: never read by Agent lifecycle scripts
